business_summary: Toyo Logistics Co., Ltd. engages in logistics and business in Japan. It operates through two segments: Logistics Business and Real Estate Business. It provides international logistics, such as import and export procedures, international transportation, overseas logistics, and port transportation; domestic logistics comprises logistics center operation, domestic transportation, mail order logistics, and distribution processing; and trunk room, including storage of various data media and artworks, document storage, books and book storage, document digitization services, and dissolving confidential documents. The company is also involved in regular and bonded warehousing and storage rooms; general port transportation, port loading, and unloading; ocean and coastal shipping; general cargo motor vehicle transportation, light cargo motor vehicle transportation, and port cargo handling; air cargo transportation agency activities; customs clearance; and non-life insurance and shipping agency activities. In addition, it engages in buying, selling, brokering, leasing, management, and utilization of real estate; construction design, supervision, contracting, distribution processing, etc.; software development and sale; and information processing. The company was incorporated in 1926 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan. Toyo Logistics Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Toray Industries, Inc.
